key_risks: Raw Material Risk: Volatility in prices of leather, synthetic materials, rubber, EVA, chemicals and other inputs may affect margins.
Demand Risk: Changes in consumer sentiment, inflation and discretionary spending can affect demand, particularly in price-sensitive segments.
Competition Risk: Increasing competition from organised domestic brands, international brands, private labels and digital-first players may exert pressure on market share and margins.
Regulatory Risk: Changes in BIS standards, quality control requirements, environmental regulations, labour regulations and other statutory requirements may increase compliance costs.
Foreign Exchange Risk: Changes in foreign exchange rates may affect the Company's export revenues, imported inputs and overall competitiveness.
Trade Risk: Changes in tariff policies, FTAs, rules of origin and geopolitical developments may affect international trade.
Inventory Risk: Rapid changes in fashion and consumer preferences can lead to shorter product life cycles and inventory obsolescence.
Sustainability Risk: Increasing environmental expectations and regulatory requirements may require investment in sustainable materials and processes.
Technology and Cyber Risk: Increasing dependence on digital commerce, technology and data systems exposes businesses to cybersecurity and technology-related risks.
